name: Benavente (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of maroon, yellow and maroon, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Benavente (a tower on red above waves).
history: The heraldic arms were approved on 27 January 2005 and published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León and the provincial bulletin of Zamora of 16 March 2005; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of three fitted horizontal stripes of equal width, maroon above and below and yellow in the centre.

features.role: Benavente arms — tower on red above waves
